```{r setup, include=FALSE}
ENIA_ROOT <- "~/ENIA-5120"
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# 1. Load players dataset
league_players <- readr::read_csv(file.path(ENIA_ROOT, "data", "laser_league_players.csv"))
glimpse(league_players)
```

```{r}
# Helper to get most common value
mode_char <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  names(which.max(table(x)))
}
```

```{r}
# 2. Engineer player-level features
players_engineered <- league_players %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    season_score = replace_na(season_score, median(season_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    assists = replace_na(assists, median(assists, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stamina_score = replace_na(stamina_score, median(stamina_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    score_per_match = season_score / pmax(matches_played, 1),
    assist_rate = assists / pmax(matches_played, 1),
    stamina_adjusted_score = score_per_match * (stamina_score / 100),
    high_glow = glow_rating >= 8,
    accuracy_bucket = case_when(
      tag_accuracy_pct >= 80 ~ "Elite",
      tag_accuracy_pct >= 65 ~ "Solid",
      TRUE ~ "Needs Work"
    ),
    energy_balance = energy_delta_pct - shield_uptime_pct
  )
players_engineered
```

```{r}
# 3. Squad-level features
squad_features <- players_engineered %>%
  group_by(squad_id, squad_name) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_score_per_match = mean(score_per_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_high_glow = mean(high_glow, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_loadout = mode_char(preferred_loadout),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
squad_features
```

```{r}
# 4. Join back to players
players_with_context <- players_engineered %>%
  left_join(squad_features, by = c("squad_id", "squad_name"))
players_with_context
```

```{r}
# 5. Feature glossary
feature_glossary <- tibble::tribble(
  ~feature_name, ~description,
  "score_per_match", "Season score divided by matches_played to normalize for volume.",
  "assist_rate", "Assists per match, highlights supportive roles.",
  "stamina_adjusted_score", "Score_per_match scaled by stamina to capture endurance.",
  "high_glow", "Boolean flag for glow_rating >= 8 (top performers).",
  "accuracy_bucket", "Categorical bucket describing accuracy tiers.",
  "energy_balance", "Difference between energy_delta_pct and shield_uptime_pct."
)
feature_glossary
```
